evidence: Modifies txorphanage and txdownloadman to change how orphan transactions are stored and accounted for over P2P.
rationale: Peers can bypass orphan memory limits and induce significant memory and CPU denial-of-service. As noted in the description, 'a transaction of 199,000 1-byte witness elements weighs 398,247WU... but uses 11.1MB of memory: 28 times what is accounted for it', allowing peers to evade per-peer and global bounds.
